messages:
Kira Tan: Quick Q from the Amsterdam conf : I took a cash advance (requested) of 00 for local transit/food but ended up using my personal card for one nights dinner and paid a 0 service charge at the hotel on check-out. I also tipped porters in cash with no receipt. How do I reconcile the advance + personal charges? Do I claim per-diem for the meals day I have receipts? cc @people-ops
Maya (People Ops): Short answer: reconcile the advance against actuals. Steps: 1) Submit all actual receipts you have and mark which were paid from the advance. 2) For personal-card charges, upload the card statement line + receipt and mark "personal card used due to advance shortfall". 3) Any unspent advance: record as "advance returned" (negative line) with bank transfer or note if you returned cash to finance. Per-diem can be used only on days you have no meal receipts; you cannot claim per-diem and meal receipts for the same day.
Ethan (Finance): Add: hotel service charge is reimbursable if it was a mandatory hotel fee (attach folio). Voluntary gratuities are treated like tips. For tips/porter cash without receipts: if <= $10 each, include under meal per-diem if you opt for per-diem that day; otherwise use lost-receipt form and manager approval if > $25. Also: ATM fees are reimbursable as actuals if they were related to business travel. Attach the ATM withdrawal and fee lines.
Sam O.: If I paid Kira back in cash 0 and she already submitted the expense, what's the cleanest flow?
Maya (People Ops): Either: a) Kira adds a negative expense line "cash returned by Sam O. \u2014 \u00e3 30" with a note and attach a photo of the cash exchange (preferred for small amounts), or b) Sam submits a small reimbursement to Kira off-platform and both parties note it in the expense description. Finance prefers (a) for auditability.
ExpenseBot: :receipt: Missing receipt policy reminder: - amount <= $25: Lost-Receipt Form acceptable - $25 < amount <= $75: Lost-Receipt Form + manager approval - amount > $75: original receipt required unless Finance exception. Required receipt fields: date, merchant, amount, currency. Preferred formats: JPEG/PNG/PDF.
Kira Tan: One more nuance: the conference organizer charged the company for a workshop add-on but my badge receipt shows my name only. Can Finance reclaim VAT on that?
Ethan (Finance): VAT reclaimable only if the invoice/receipt is issued to Redwood Inference (company name/address). If organizer can reissue an invoice to the company, upload that. If not, submit it as a reimbursable expense and flag "VAT reclaim"; Finance will evaluate but likely won't be able to reclaim.
Maya (People Ops): Helpful template to paste into the expense description for advances/unspent cash:
```
Expense: Conference miscellany / advance reconciliation
Advance amount: 00 EUR (requested 2026-03-05)
Actuals: transit 24.00 EUR (cash), hotel service charge 10.00 EUR (card), dinner 48.00 EUR (personal card)
Advance applied: 24.00 EUR
Advance returned: 26.00 EUR (cash returned to Finance 2026-03-09)
Notes: attached receipts, card statement line for personal card; ATM fee 3.00 EUR attached
```
Maya (People Ops): If you returned cash physically, Finance may ask for a short attestation from your manager for amounts > \u00a3100. For smaller returns, photo + note is fine.
Kira Tan: Perfect : I'll upload all receipts, add the negative line for the returned cash and include the card statement. Thanks!! :thumbsup:
